31: /**
32:  * This reader walks the elements of a JsonElement as if it was coming from a
33:  * character stream.
34:  *
35:  * @author Jesse Wilson
36:  */
37: public final class JsonTreeReader extends JsonReader {
38:   private static final Reader UNREADABLE_READER = new Reader() {
39:     @Override public int read(char[] buffer, int offset, int count) throws IOException {
40:       throw new AssertionError();
41:     }
42:     @Override public void close() throws IOException {
43:       throw new AssertionError();
44:     }
45:   };
46:   private static final Object SENTINEL_CLOSED = new Object();
47: 
48:   /*
49:    * The nesting stack. Using a manual array rather than an ArrayList saves 20%.
50:    */
51:   private Object[] stack = new Object[32];
52:   private int stackSize = 0;
53: 
54:   /*
55:    * The path members. It corresponds directly to stack: At indices where the
56:    * stack contains an object (EMPTY_OBJECT, DANGLING_NAME or NONEMPTY_OBJECT),
57:    * pathNames contains the name at this scope. Where it contains an array
58:    * (EMPTY_ARRAY, NONEMPTY_ARRAY) pathIndices contains the current index in
59:    * that array. Otherwise the value is undefined, and we take advantage of that
60:    * by incrementing pathIndices when doing so isn't useful.
61:    */
62:   private String[] pathNames = new String[32];
63:   private int[] pathIndices = new int[32];
64: 
65:   public JsonTreeReader(JsonElement element) {
66:     super(UNREADABLE_READER);
67:     push(element);
68:   }
69: 
70:   @Override public void beginArray() throws IOException {
71:     expect(JsonToken.BEGIN_ARRAY);
72:     JsonArray array = (JsonArray) peekStack();
73:     push(array.iterator());
74:     pathIndices[stackSize - 1] = 0;
75:   }
76: 
77:   @Override public void endArray() throws IOException {
78:     expect(JsonToken.END_ARRAY);
79:     popStack(); // empty iterator
80:     popStack(); // array
81:     if (stackSize > 0) {
82:       pathIndices[stackSize - 1]++;
83:     }
84:   }
85: 
86:   @Override public void beginObject() throws IOException {
87:     expect(JsonToken.BEGIN_OBJECT);
88:     JsonObject object = (JsonObject) peekStack();
89:     push(object.entrySet().iterator());
90:   }
91: 
92:   @Override public void endObject() throws IOException {
93:     expect(JsonToken.END_OBJECT);
94:     popStack(); // empty iterator
95:     popStack(); // object
96:     if (stackSize > 0) {
97:       pathIndices[stackSize - 1]++;
98:     }
99:   }
100: 
101:   @Override public boolean hasNext() throws IOException {
102:     JsonToken token = peek();
103:     return token != JsonToken.END_OBJECT && token != JsonToken.END_ARRAY;
104:   }
105: 
106:   @Override public JsonToken peek() throws IOException {
107:     if (stackSize == 0) {
108:       return JsonToken.END_DOCUMENT;
109:     }
110: 
111:     Object o = peekStack();
112:     if (o instanceof Iterator) {
113:       boolean isObject = stack[stackSize - 2] instanceof JsonObject;
114:       Iterator<?> iterator = (Iterator<?>) o;
115:       if (iterator.hasNext()) {
116:         if (isObject) {
117:           return JsonToken.NAME;
118:         } else {
119:           push(iterator.next());
120:           return peek();
121:         }
122:       } else {
123:         return isObject ? JsonToken.END_OBJECT : JsonToken.END_ARRAY;
124:       }
125:     } else if (o instanceof JsonObject) {
126:       return JsonToken.BEGIN_OBJECT;
127:     } else if (o instanceof JsonArray) {
128:       return JsonToken.BEGIN_ARRAY;
129:     } else if (o instanceof JsonPrimitive) {
130:       JsonPrimitive primitive = (JsonPrimitive) o;
131:       if (primitive.isString()) {
132:         return JsonToken.STRING;
133:       } else if (primitive.isBoolean()) {
134:         return JsonToken.BOOLEAN;
135:       } else if (primitive.isNumber()) {
136:         return JsonToken.NUMBER;
137:       } else {
138:         throw new AssertionError();
139:       }
140:     } else if (o instanceof JsonNull) {
141:       return JsonToken.NULL;
142:     } else if (o == SENTINEL_CLOSED) {
143:       throw new IllegalStateException("JsonReader is closed");
144:     } else {
145:       throw new AssertionError();
146:     }
147:   }
148: 
149:   private Object peekStack() {
150:     return stack[stackSize - 1];
151:   }
152: 
153:   private Object popStack() {
154:     Object result = stack[--stackSize];
155:     stack[stackSize] = null;
156:     return result;
157:   }
158: 
159:   private void expect(JsonToken expected) throws IOException {
160:     if (peek() != expected) {
161:       throw new IllegalStateException(
162:           "Expected " + expected + " but was " + peek() + locationString());
163:     }
164:   }
165: 
166:   @Override public String nextName() throws IOException {
167:     expect(JsonToken.NAME);
168:     Iterator<?> i = (Iterator<?>) peekStack();
169:     Map.Entry<?, ?> entry = (Map.Entry<?, ?>) i.next();
170:     String result = (String) entry.getKey();
171:     pathNames[stackSize - 1] = result;
172:     push(entry.getValue());
173:     return result;
174:   }
175: 
176:   @Override public String nextString() throws IOException {
177:     JsonToken token = peek();
178:     if (token != JsonToken.STRING && token != JsonToken.NUMBER) {
179:       throw new IllegalStateException(
180:           "Expected " + JsonToken.STRING + " but was " + token + locationString());
181:     }
182:     String result = ((JsonPrimitive) popStack()).getAsString();
183:     if (stackSize > 0) {
184:       pathIndices[stackSize - 1]++;
185:     }
186:     return result;
187:   }
188: 
189:   @Override public boolean nextBoolean() throws IOException {
190:     expect(JsonToken.BOOLEAN);
191:     boolean result = ((JsonPrimitive) popStack()).getAsBoolean();
192:     if (stackSize > 0) {
193:       pathIndices[stackSize - 1]++;
194:     }
195:     return result;
196:   }
197: 
198:   @Override public void nextNull() throws IOException {
199:     expect(JsonToken.NULL);
200:     popStack();
201:     if (stackSize > 0) {
202:       pathIndices[stackSize - 1]++;
203:     }
204:   }
205: 
206:   @Override public double nextDouble() throws IOException {
207:     JsonToken token = peek();
208:     if (token != JsonToken.NUMBER && token != JsonToken.STRING) {
209:       throw new IllegalStateException(
210:           "Expected " + JsonToken.NUMBER + " but was " + token + locationString());
211:     }
212:     double result = ((JsonPrimitive) peekStack()).getAsDouble();
213:     if (!isLenient() && (Double.isNaN(result) || Double.isInfinite(result))) {
214:       throw new NumberFormatException("JSON forbids NaN and infinities: " + result);
215:     }
216:     popStack();
217:     if (stackSize > 0) {
218:       pathIndices[stackSize - 1]++;
219:     }
220:     return result;
221:   }
222: 
223:   @Override public long nextLong() throws IOException {
224:     JsonToken token = peek();
225:     if (token != JsonToken.NUMBER && token != JsonToken.STRING) {
226:       throw new IllegalStateException(
227:           "Expected " + JsonToken.NUMBER + " but was " + token + locationString());
228:     }
229:     long result = ((JsonPrimitive) peekStack()).getAsLong();
230:     popStack();
231:     if (stackSize > 0) {
232:       pathIndices[stackSize - 1]++;
233:     }
234:     return result;
235:   }
236: 
237:   @Override public int nextInt() throws IOException {
238:     JsonToken token = peek();
239:     if (token != JsonToken.NUMBER && token != JsonToken.STRING) {
240:       throw new IllegalStateException(
241:           "Expected " + JsonToken.NUMBER + " but was " + token + locationString());
242:     }
243:     int result = ((JsonPrimitive) peekStack()).getAsInt();
244:     popStack();
245:     if (stackSize > 0) {
246:       pathIndices[stackSize - 1]++;
247:     }
248:     return result;
249:   }
250: 
251:   @Override public void close() throws IOException {
252:     stack = new Object[] { SENTINEL_CLOSED };
253:     stackSize = 1;
254:   }
255: 
256:   @Override public void skipValue() throws IOException {
257:     if (peek() == JsonToken.NAME) {
258:       nextName();
259:       pathNames[stackSize - 2] = "null";
260:     } else {
261:       popStack();
262:       pathNames[stackSize - 1] = "null";
263:     }
264:     pathIndices[stackSize - 1]++;
265:   }
266: 
267:   @Override public String toString() {
268:     return getClass().getSimpleName();
269:   }
270: 
271:   public void promoteNameToValue() throws IOException {
272:     expect(JsonToken.NAME);
273:     Iterator<?> i = (Iterator<?>) peekStack();
274:     Map.Entry<?, ?> entry = (Map.Entry<?, ?>) i.next();
275:     push(entry.getValue());
276:     push(new JsonPrimitive((String) entry.getKey()));
277:   }
278: 
279:   private void push(Object newTop) {
280:     if (stackSize == stack.length) {
281:       Object[] newStack = new Object[stackSize * 2];
282:       int[] newPathIndices = new int[stackSize * 2];
283:       String[] newPathNames = new String[stackSize * 2];
284:       System.arraycopy(stack, 0, newStack, 0, stackSize);
285:       System.arraycopy(pathIndices, 0, newPathIndices, 0, stackSize);
286:       System.arraycopy(pathNames, 0, newPathNames, 0, stackSize);
287:       stack = newStack;
288:       pathIndices = newPathIndices;
289:       pathNames = newPathNames;
290:     }
291:     stack[stackSize++] = newTop;
292:   }
293: 
294:   @Override public String getPath() {
295:     StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder().append('$');
296:     for (int i = 0; i < stackSize; i++) {
297:       if (stack[i] instanceof JsonArray) {
298:         if (stack[++i] instanceof Iterator) {
299:           result.append('[').append(pathIndices[i]).append(']');
300:         }
301:       } else if (stack[i] instanceof JsonObject) {
302:         if (stack[++i] instanceof Iterator) {
303:           result.append('.');
304:           if (pathNames[i] != null) {
305:             result.append(pathNames[i]);
306:           }
307:         }
308:       }
309:     }
310:     return result.toString();
311:   }
312: 
313:   private String locationString() {
314:     return " at path " + getPath();
315:   }
316: }

part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in `JsonTreeReader.skipValue()` (gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/internal/bind/JsonTreeReader.java:256): after `popStack()` emptied the stack, it unconditionally indexed `pathNames[stackSize - 1]` and `pathIndices[stackSize - 1]`, causing the `ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException` when skipping a top-level value. Added `stackSize > 0` guards, matching the pattern already used in the other `next*` methods.

Verification:
- `JsonTreeReaderTest` (includes the skipValue-at-root case) and `JsonReaderTest`: 121 tests pass.
- Full `gson` module suite: only 6 pre-existing locale/JDK-related failures (`DefaultDateTypeAdapterTest`, `DefaultTypeAdaptersTest`, `ObjectTest`), confirmed identical on the pristine tree via `git stash`.
